name: Tianwen-1 Lander
about: Tianwen-1 Lander (2020-049, LDSE/CAST), launched 2020 Jul 23. Its phases from GCAT: Mars, HCO. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Mars on GCAT's date); its perihelion 1.014 au and aphelion 1.635 au against GCAT's 1.016 and 1.603
